title: Week in the Life On-call as a Software Engineer in NYC

So for those of you who don't know, what is an on-call shift for software engineers?
Imagine your normal workday ends but you're still depressed and your team relies on if
something breaks.
During your on-call shift, you keep your phone close because any issue that affects users
or breaks any systems can trigger an alert that sounds like this.
When that alert hits, you jump in fast, figure out what's wrong and either fix it yourself
or loop in the right team.
It's basically being the emergency responder for your systems.
It is stressful but I'd say you learn a lot because you see how your product actually
behaves under real pressure.
